decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch still mentioned in 2024, it looks weaker than the more prominently promoted products but not weak enough to close the option while market learning is still ongoing and carrying costs are likely modest for a large machinery firm.

Its own product page in both 2023 and 2024 suggests continued commercial commitment, so under real options logic we would keep it on the market because uncertainty is still resolving and there is no clear failure signal.

The product retained its own page through 2024, indicating viable prospects, though as a specialized high-resolution printer it likely faces somewhat narrower demand than B and therefore a slightly higher exit risk.
A 2024 launch shown on the home page appears strategically important and too new to judge fully, so we would keep this option open rather than abandon it after such a short market test.

The specifically announced 2024 launch with its own page signals an active push into the market, and for a large established German manufacturer the option value of continuing the rollout still outweighs near-term withdrawal.
Although only mentioned on the website, the trade-fair award provides positive external validation, so it is sensible to keep the product and learn more before considering abandonment.
